map.算例：σb800/Δσ200/σm100/Kt2.0/设计50万次/磨削β0.8: Example: σb800 / Δσ200 / σm100 / Kt2.0 / design 500,000 cycles / ground β0.8
map.输入：σb=800 MPa、Δσ=200 MPa、σm=100 MPa、Kt=2: Input: σb=800 MPa, Δσ=200 MPa, σm=100 MPa, Kt=2.0, design life 500,000 cycles, surface ground β=0.8. Fatigue limit σE = σb×0.5×β/Kt = 800×0.5×0.8/2.0 = 160.0 MPa; Goodman equivalent stress σEq = Δσ/2/(1−σm/σb) = 200/2/(1−100/800) = 114.29 MPa; with the S-N curve (exponent m=5) the achievable life N = (σE/σEq)^5×10⁶ = (160/114.29)^5×10⁶ ≈ 5.378 million cycles; safety factor sf = N/designN = 537.8/50 = 10.76 → safe. By comparison the default (σb600 / Kt2.0 / design 1,000,000) gives σE=120, σEq=120, N=1 million cycles, sf=1.00 → critical, showing that raising the material strength improves life exponentially.
map.Goodman 修正和 S-N 曲线是什么？: What are the Goodman correction and the S-N curve?
map.Goodman 直线将平均应力对疲劳强度的削弱线性折算到等效应力；S-N 曲线描: The Goodman line linearly converts the weakening effect of mean stress on fatigue strength into an equivalent stress; the S-N curve describes the power-law relation between stress amplitude and the number of cycles to failure, and this tool takes m=5 (a common approximation for steel and adhesive joints). Together they give an engineering estimate when no experimental curve is available.
map.安全系数 sf=1 就代表刚好够用吗？: Does a safety factor sf=1 mean it is just good enough?
map.不。sf=1 只是理论寿命等于设计寿命，未留余量；工程上要求 sf≥2（实际寿命: No. sf=1 only means the theoretical life equals the design life, with no margin; engineering practice requires sf≥2 (actual life ≥2× the design life) to count as reliable. sf between 1 and 2 is "critical" and needs optimization (lower stress / change material / reduce Kt), and <1 is "unsafe" and requires a design change.
